description: This source file defines a 'PlaylistAdapter' class for use in Android applications, specifically for displaying playlists in a RecyclerView. It manages view binding, view holder creation, and efficient list diffing to handle playlist data updates.

classes.name: PlaylistAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for displaying Playlist objects in a RecyclerView, handles item view creation, binding, and click events.

classes.name: PlaylistViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder for Playlist items, manages binding playlist data to UI components and handling item clicks.

classes.name: PlaylistDiffCallback
classes.description: DiffUtil callback implementation to optimize RecyclerView updates by comparing playlist items.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new ViewHolder object by inflating the item layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds playlist data to the provided ViewHolder.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a Playlist object's data to the UI components within the ViewHolder.

methods.name: areItemsTheSame
methods.description: Checks if two Playlist objects represent the same item based on their IDs.

methods.name: areContentsTheSame
methods.description: Checks if two Playlist objects have the same content.
